user.title: Connect to your Groundskeeper panel
user.description: Home Assistant talks to the panel, never to the robot. Make an API token in the panel under Settings → Access, then paste it here. This version only reads: it sends nothing to the robot.

data_description.url: Where you open the panel, for example http://192.0.2.20:8425. In Docker, use the IP address rather than a .local name.
data_description.api_token: Starts with gk_. The panel shows it once, when you make it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only matters for an https address. Turn it off for a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The panel at {url} refused the saved token. Make a new one in the panel under Settings → Access and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the panel. Check the address and port, and that Home Assistant can reach that machine.
error.invalid_auth: The panel refused this token. Make a new one in the panel under Settings → Access.
error.invalid_url: Enter the address you open the panel at, like http://192.0.2.20:8425.
error.panel_too_old: This panel has no Home Assistant summary yet. Update Groundskeeper to the latest release.
error.unsupported_api: This panel is newer than the integration. Update the Groundskeeper integration in HACS.
error.no_robot: The panel hasn't heard from the robot yet. Check the robot connection in the panel, then try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This robot is already set up. Its address and token were updated.
abort.wrong_robot: That token belongs to a panel for a different robot.

init.title: What to follow live
init.description: What Groundskeeper follows live from the panel. Only the device tracker records a position.

data_description.map: The yard map and live position, for the card only: never in history.
data_description.follow_camera: Which Frigate camera covers the robot: a sensor (recorded) and a camera.
data_description.device_tracker: The robot on Home Assistant's map. Its position is kept in history.
